en: In-force premium grew 32.5% to $1.43B, the 11th straight quarter of faster growth, and revenue jumped 79% to $294M, just ahead of the ~$291M consensus; the net loss of $0.56 a share matched estimates. Gross profit rose 76% to $113M and the adjusted EBITDA loss shrank 54% to $19M. CEO Daniel Schreiber reaffirmed the first positive adjusted EBITDA quarter in Q4, which CFO Tim Bixby put at about $8M, and revenue guidance was raised to $1.21–1.22B.

The stock fell 24% on the day, from $62 to $47, as investors focused on growth spending rising faster than expected and the slow path to profit. It bounced to $54 a week later but drifted lower into September, hitting a 52-week low near $44. A CFO change announced alongside the results added to the caution.
zh: 有效保费增长 32.5% 至 14.3 亿美元，连续 11 季加速；营收大增 79% 至 2.94 亿美元，略高于约 2.91 亿的预期；每股净亏损 0.56 美元，与预期一致。毛利增长 76% 至 1.13 亿美元，调整后 EBITDA 亏损收窄 54% 至 1900 万。CEO 丹尼尔·施赖伯重申 Q4 将迎来首个调整后 EBITDA 为正的季度，CFO 蒂姆·比克斯比预计约 800 万美元，营收指引上调至 12.1–12.2 亿。
投资者聚焦增长开支增速超预期及盈利之路漫长，股价当天从 62 美元跌 24% 至 47 美元。一周后反弹至 54 美元，但9月再度走低，触及约 44 美元的52周低点。与业绩一同公布的 CFO 变动也加重了观望情绪。

bio.en: Co-founded Lemonade in 2015 with Shai Wininger and has led it since; also chairman. Previously president of wireless-charging company Powermat and an executive at SanDisk/M-Systems; trained as a lawyer at King's College London.
bio.zh: 2015 年与沙伊·维宁格联合创办 Lemonade 并一直领导公司，兼任董事长。此前任无线充电公司 Powermat 总裁，并曾任职于 SanDisk/M-Systems；毕业于伦敦国王学院法律系。

bio.en: CFO since 2017 and moving to the board on Jan 1, 2027. Previously CFO of Shutterstock and CFO and president of LivePerson; Dartmouth graduate with a Harvard MBA.
bio.zh: 2017 年起任 CFO，将于 2027年1月1日转任董事。此前任 Shutterstock 的 CFO，以及 LivePerson 的 CFO 兼总裁；达特茅斯学院毕业，哈佛 MBA。
